# ARQR360

> ARQR360 turns a store's product photos into true-to-size AR (Augmented Reality) catalogues. Shoppers scan one QR code and see furniture, rugs, decor, or footwear at real size in their own room, with no app to download.

## What it does

- Builds true-to-size AR (Augmented Reality) views from product photographs, made to the product's real measurements.
- Each catalogue lives at a short link (for example arqr360.com/novara) and a QR code the store prints or puts online.
- Shoppers open it on their phone camera: iPhone uses Quick Look, Android uses Scene Viewer. Nothing to install.
- The store gets fewer returns, because customers see true size before buying.
- The ARQR360 team does the modelling, hosting, and QR codes. The store only sends photos and dimensions.

## Who it is for

Furniture, rug, home decor, and footwear retailers in the USA, Canada, UK, Europe, UAE and Gulf, Australia, New Zealand, and selected APAC markets who sell online or from a showroom.

## Pricing (USD)

- Starter: $249 one-time setup + $29/month, 10 products.
- Studio: $549 one-time setup + $59/month, 25 products.
- Showroom: $999 one-time setup + $99/month, 50 products.
- Extra products: $20 each. Larger or multi-store catalogues: custom quote.
- Founding stores (first 50): $199 setup + $19/month, locked for life.
- One free true-to-size AR model of a bestseller, no commitment, to try on your own phone.

## How a store starts

1. The store sends photos and real dimensions of its products.
2. ARQR360 builds the AR views and the catalogue in about seven days.
3. The store shares the QR code or link; customers view products in AR.
